title: Good faith in the early enforceability cases
shortTitle: Good faith in the early enforceability cases
summary: Good faith supplies a concrete limit in the satisfaction and variable-quantity cases assigned so far.
notes: In Mattei it limits satisfaction judgment. In Structural Polymer it constrains requirements. These functions help identify what obligation exists for consideration purposes. They should not be expanded into a complete outline of the later unit on performance in good faith, which includes different cases and questions.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 102–117. Open assigned page 102.
